text_block_list.text:
At long last, these cleats of the Overlord
stand
alongside those of the previous
generation's
heroes!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
To the assassin, Doto—she who sharpens
her
blades in the shadows—I declare
that our swords
will clash at the
Takarazuka Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
Ahh, I feel it! Astonishment, envy, and
alarm well
from within Doto, the heroes
of the old, and all
others.
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... My true test as Overlord
begins now!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
